title: 第一卷 第1章 大爱师尊第一卷 第2章 徒弟一枚
slug: 百倍返还我家孽徒全是女帝转世
content_zh:
天玄大陆，东荒。
相传，万年前。
在大楚国境内，清溪镇的后方有一座青山，名为青云山。
青山高耸入云，犹如擎天。
后有一位绝世高人来到此处，一手叉腰，一手持剑，从山腰处，将青云山脉一剑劈开，从此开宗立派，建立了远近闻名的青云宫。
青云宫内一共有着九座主峰，里面居住着神仙，他们授徒、教人，可以传授凡人仙法，习得长生之道。
宫中弟子虽然少，每一个却都有着天纵之资，堪称一方妖孽。
特别是九大峰主之一的林枫。
传闻中，他的骨龄尚不足三十，修为却已臻至元婴境十层，距离化神之境也不过是一步之遥，仅次于当代青云宫掌教，在大楚国境内极具个人传奇色彩。
而青云宫更是实力强大，底蕴深厚，传承至今，已有万年之久，位列大楚的四大仙门之首。
就算放在整个东域来看，也是称霸一方的存在。
只是可惜，十年前魔道入侵大楚，血洗了诸多正道仙门，青云宫自然也被牵连其中。
那一战，宫中诸多弟子、长老陨落，当代掌教也是身中魔毒，一直闭关至今。
而最惨的莫过于小竹峰峰主林枫……
同样在这场战斗中，林枫身受重伤，身体受到了不可逆转的伤害，导致金丹破碎，修为一路连跌三大境界，停留在了筑基境的初期。
终生无法再凝丹。
这不禁让人唏嘘不已。
没有了掌教与林枫坐镇，青云宫实力自然大不如前，显些跌出四大仙门之列。
……
此刻，小竹峰上。

“十年！”
“十年了啊！”
“你知道我这十年是怎么过来的吗！？”
一个头发凌乱的中年男子背靠老松，仰天怒骂道。
“唉……别人穿越都是逆天体质，无敌背景，开局牛逼哄哄吊炸天，各种装逼打脸。
而我倒好，偏偏穿越成了一个落魄峰主，修为下跌就算了，还要终日守着这座荒山，这什么时候才是个头啊！”
半晌之后，林枫长叹一口气。
没人知道，他其实是一个蓝星上的穿越者。
十年前穿越了这方世界。
刚开始穿越时，通过记忆碎片得知自己的身份是青云宫峰主之后，他极度兴奋，还以为开局就是满级账号，以后都不用努力了。
结果在了解情况后，他懵逼了！
自己居然是个废物！
还是被魔道修士给活生生的打废的。
content_en:
Tianxuan Continent, Eastern Wasteland.
According to legend, thousands of years ago.
In the territory of Da Chu Kingdom, there is a green mountain behind Qingxi Town called Qingyun Mountain.
The green mountains tower into the clouds, as if they are holding up the sky.
Later, a peerless master came here, with one hand on his waist and a sword in the other, splitting the Qingyun Mountains from the mountainside with a sword. From then on, he established a sect and established the Qingyun Palace, which is famous far and wide.
There are a total of nine main peaks in Qingyun Palace, where immortals live. They teach disciples and teach people. They can teach mortals immortal magic and learn the way to immortality.
Although there are few disciples in the palace, every one of them has the talent of heaven and can be called a monster.
Especially Lin Feng, one of the nine peak masters.
According to rumors, his bone age is less than thirty, but his cultivation has reached the tenth level of the Nascent Soul Realm. He is only one step away from the realm of divine transformation. He is second only to the contemporary headmaster of Qingyun Palace. He is a personal legend in the Great Chu Kingdom.
Qingyun Palace is even more powerful and has a profound heritage. It has been passed down for thousands of years and ranks first among the four major immortal sects in Da Chu.
Even if you look at the entire Eastern Region, it is still the dominant one.
It's a pity that the demonic way invaded Dachu ten years ago and bloodbathed many righteous immortal sects. Qingyun Palace was naturally implicated.
In that battle, many disciples and elders in the palace died. The current headmaster was also poisoned by demons and has been in seclusion to this day.
And the worst thing is none other than Lin Feng, the leader of Xiaozhu Peak...
Also in this battle, Lin Feng was seriously injured, and his body suffered irreversible damage, which caused the golden elixir to break. His cultivation level dropped three levels in a row, and he stayed at the early stage of the foundation building level.
I will never be able to condense the elixir again for the rest of my life.
This can't help but make people sigh.
Without the headmaster and Lin Feng in charge, the strength of Qingyun Palace is naturally not as good as before, and it seems to have fallen out of the four major immortal sects.
…
At this moment, on Xiaozhu Peak.
"Ten years!"
"Ten years!"
"Do you know how I got here these ten years!?"
A middle-aged man with messy hair leaned against Lao Song, looking up to the sky and cursing angrily.
"Sigh... Others who have traveled through time have incredible physiques, invincible backgrounds, awesome starts, and all kinds of pretense to slap people in the face.
As for me, I happened to travel through time and became a desolate peak master. Even if my cultivation level dropped, I still have to guard this barren mountain all day long. When will this end? "
After a while, Lin Feng let out a long sigh.
No one knows that he is actually a time traveler on the Blue Star.
I traveled through this world ten years ago.
When he first started traveling through memory, he was extremely excited after learning that he was the peak master of Qingyun Palace through memory fragments. He thought he would have a full-level account at the beginning and would not have to work hard in the future.
As a result, after understanding the situation, he was confused!
I am actually a waste!
He was still beaten alive by the demonic monks.
